input.code:
def process(fire_weather):
    df = fire_weather
    overall_mean = df['fatalities_last'].dropna().mean()
    low_hum = df[df['avrh_mean'] < 30]
    low_hum_mean = low_hum['fatalities_last'].dropna().mean()
    diff = low_hum_mean - overall_mean
    return pd.DataFrame({'overall_mean':[overall_mean],'low_hum_mean':[low_hum_mean],'diff':[diff]})
input.summary: Compute mean fatalities overall and for rows with avrh_mean < 30, return their difference (low_hum_mean - overall_mean).
